app/_layout.tsx.guard: the page-title effect and the error-listener effect each return early unless Platform.OS === 'web'

components/InstallPrompt.tsx.guard: the install prompt is for the web app only: isEligibleBrowserContext() returns false unless Platform.OS === 'web', and the effect and the iOS hint only run after it

components/friend-code.tsx.guard: native shares through React Native's Share (Platform.OS !== 'web' branch); navigator.share is reached only on the web, after a typeof check

lib/app-active.ts.guard: document is read only when Platform.OS === 'web'; native uses AppState

lib/game.ts.guard: the visibility handler that reads document.hidden is added and removed only when Platform.OS === 'web'; native uses AppState

lib/keyboard-walk.ts.guard: the key listeners are added only after `Platform.OS !== 'web'` returns early (keyboard walking is a web extra)

lib/posthog.ts.guard: initPostHog returns early unless Platform.OS === 'web', and loads posthog-js with import() after it

lib/registerServiceWorker.ts.guard: returns early unless Platform.OS === 'web' (a service worker is a web-only offline cache)

lib/reportPreviewError.ts.guard: only typeof guards, so it does run on native: document is undefined there (getTargetOrigin returns '*'), window.parent is undefined so postMessage throws inside its try and is ignored. Harmless, but a Platform.OS === 'web' check would be clearer

lib/sound.ts.guard: the first-gesture listeners are added and removed only when Platform.OS === 'web' (browsers block audio until a gesture; native plays at once)
